purpose: Make Legacy pre-run case materialization and ordinary single-mission replay executable without preserving Legacy case numbering, directory names or runtime APIs.

provenance.notes: The frozen gnc_sim from the clean R0-LEG-001 build ran --simflow and then plain --config twice. Each ordinary replay used a standalone effective-mission copy and a distinct fresh working root. The main build consumes only pinned missions, datasets, summaries and traces plus independent Python/C++ references; it has no Legacy include, link or runtime dependency.

expected_facts.claim: Matrix row hot injects engine.temp_level=2 and aero.drag_bias=-0.03 into a self-contained effective mission before runtime execution.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Source row, case label, vehicle, distinct field identities and numeric values are exact after JSON parsing and output-location exclusion; effective-mission JSON member order/whitespace, requested-input declaration order and case-source column order are excluded.

expected_facts.claim: The materialized hot mission succeeds through plain gnc_sim --config from a distinct fresh working root and produces the same semantic dataset as its SimFlow execution.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Semantic input role/order, exit code, fresh replay root, standalone effective-mission input and absent output path are exact; Legacy entrypoint/mode spelling is pinned as capture provenance and excluded from semantic equality; dataset row identity is exact, encoded column order is excluded after header mapping, and frozen scalar values use absolute tolerance 1e-12.

expected_facts.claim: Legacy case index and directory name do not participate in effective-mission or replay semantic equality.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Source case and mission/dataset semantics remain exact; Legacy directory, numeric index, case-manifest absence and JSON/CSV encoding order are excluded.

expected_facts.claim: The capture is tied to the frozen archive, CLI, SimFlow runner/materializer sources, passing runtime tests, environment, harness and raw artifact identities.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Paths, byte counts, line-ending reconstruction and SHA-256 values are exact.

acceptance: Verifies frozen source, environment, harness, runtime-test and raw capture identities
Each SimFlow invocation and plain replay starts from a distinct fresh working root; replay uses a standalone effective-mission copy and creates an absent dataset path
Two effective missions, two summaries and all four SimFlow/replay datasets are byte-identical
Independent Python materialization and C++17 typed mission probes agree on the hot inputs after JSON re-encoding, requested-input reordering and case-source column reordering
Plain --config replay succeeds twice and matches SimFlow output by semantic dataset fields after full dataset-column reversal
Missing injected input, hidden SimFlow replay context, reused batch root, case-local replay input and replay-result mismatch are rejected
Legacy case index/directory changes and target case-manifest presence are accepted after semantic normalization; manifest content and identity remain pending
Legacy CLI entrypoint/mode spelling changes are accepted after materialization and effective-mission input roles are resolved
Preserve and Retire recommendations remain pending until the repository owner accepts the disposition choice
